slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
SAS Similarity: if an angle of one triangle equals an angle of another, and the sides including those angles are proportional, the triangles are similar.

SSS Similarity: if the three sides of one triangle are proportional to the three sides of another, the triangles are similar.

Both are proved like AA: dilate one triangle so a pair of corresponding sides becomes equal, then use the congruence tests SAS or SSS. Check ratios by sorting sides from shortest to longest and comparing in order.
